questions: Did s-bend line_loss_events fall below 1.3 per run, and did max_error drop below 0.06 m? Report off-track counts per track.
Did slalom line_loss_events fall from 1.95 per run? If not, is the slalom loss a controller-response problem (for example kp, kd or line_loss mode) rather than a geometry one?
Did the oval finish rate hold at 16/20 or better, and did oval steering_oscillation rise above about 0.35? If it did, rule (d) applies and wheel_track should return to 0.10 m.
Given the flat result from 0.11 to 0.10 m, do you see any evidence that further narrowing is still worth testing, or should the next iteration move to controller weights?
feedback_request.suggested_changes_to_test: If the oval holds and s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below, keep 0.09 m. If the oval drops below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return to 0.10 m. Do not go narrower than 0.09 m in any case.

intent: Single-step test of turn authority: narrow wheel_track from 0.10 to 0.09 m, keeping the iteration 5 sensor row (y = 0.07 m, span ±0.03 m at 0.015 m spacing), 0.012 m footprint, mass 0.7 kg, wheel_radius 0.03 m and body unchanged. The aim is to bring s-bend and slalom line-loss toward 1.0 per run while keeping the oval at 16/20 or better. The Integrator should keep the controller unchanged so the race isolates wheel_track.
learning: Iterations 4 and 5 show that forward position mainly helped the oval, and that wheel_track narrowing from 0.11 to 0.10 m changed the sharp tracks only slightly. If wheel_track 0.09 also leaves slalom line-loss near 1.9, the remaining gap is most likely the controller's response on sharp bends, not the body geometry.
rationale: Iteration 5 narrowed wheel_track from 0.11 to 0.10 m, keeping the iteration 4 geometry. Score was 362.5, essentially flat against iteration 4's 364.1. The oval held at 17/20 finishes, up from 16/20, with max_error 0.036 m. s-bend line-loss fell only slightly, from 1.4 to 1.3 per run, with max_error 0.063 m and 0/20 finishes. Slalom line-loss stayed at 1.95 with max_error 0.067 m. The narrowing therefore gave a small gain on s-bend and none on slalom. Span, footprint, forward position and speed have all been ruled out or shown not to limit (iterations 2, 3, 4 and the 1.8 s oval finish). Turn authority is the only geometry lever still moving, and its effect so far is small. The Integrator's decision rule (b) applies: line-loss on s-bend remains above 1.0 with max_error near 0.06 m, and the oval holds at 16/20 or better. Rule (b) therefore allows one further single step to wheel_track 0.09 m, with every other value unchanged. I do not go further than 0.09 m. Rule (c) is a warning for the Integrator, who should look at controller weights if slalom line-loss stays near 1.95 at this width. Expected result: s-bend line-loss falls to about 1.0 to 1.2 per run, and the oval keeps 16/20 or better. Slalom may stay at about 1.9, which would point to the controller rather than the geometry.
